comments.body:
Closing against the sprint board. `a_25S2bdrTD` adds RAD40017, a warning when an interpolation holds a constant literal - which is exactly the `"\\d{4}"` regex-constraint case this card describes. The escape hatches are `\{` and `r"..."`, both named in the diagnostic's help line.

Note the warning is only surfaced by `rad check` and the editor; running a script filters diagnostics to errors only (`core/script_meta.go:113`).
comments.author: Alexander Terp
